text:
hana: small PSA  my retro lava lamp decided to become a rogue wifi appliance this morning. 20 mins of reconnecting before i realized it. image: (lava-lamp-next-to-router.jpg) https://photos.example.com/retro123
mike: omg classic. lava lamp: 1, hanas wifi: 0 :joy:
oz: did it start emitting an SSID called LAVA-LAN? :rofl:
hana: not an SSID, just flaky packets whenever the blobs bubbled. turned out heat + alcoves on my shelf were frying the router. unplugged lamp = instant recovery.
ops-bot: triggered by hana at 2151000008  quick check: avg ping to staging before unplug 290ms, after unplug 18ms. full logs sent to #eng-infra.
sasha: solution thread idea: "weirdest thing that killed my wifi" show-and-tell tomorrow? winners get a sticker and fame.
mike: yes please. i'll bring my cat-on-modem photo.
oz: i have a plant that keeps sprouting into the router vents. it sounds like an excuse to buy a new shelf.
hana: pro-tip i learned: keep router off metal shelves and away from heavy glass. elevation helps.
ops-bot: FYI if anyone wants a quick locality scan for overlapping home APs, react with :warning: and i'll DM you a small script.
sasha: polling: morning or late-afternoon show-and-tell? react :one: for 9am, :two: for 3pm.
mike: :two:
hana: :two: (need time to exile the lamp)
oz: :one: (i'll post now, no cleanup)
ops-bot: poll update at 2151000036  :one: 1 vote, :two: 2 votes. 3pm wins.
sasha: perfect. bring your mess, memes, and wifi horror stories. also sending hana a sympathy gif: https://giphy.com/gifs/lavalamp-woops
hana: thanks team. lamp is now quarantined to the closet. if anyone needs me i'll be renaming my network to NOT-LAVA. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
